blurb: Guests fish in Tampa Bay and Boca Grande waters targeting species like snook, redfish, trout, tarpon, permit, kingfish, snapper, and grouper. The captain is USCG licensed and uses a custom 25 ft Marauder Marine Avenger bay boat equipped for both inshore and offshore fishing. They offer charters for novices, experienced anglers, kids, families, and corporate groups.
extraNote: $200 deposit required for inshore fishing charters, refundable up to 14 days before charter · $500 non-refundable deposit required for tarpon and permit fishing charters · During April-June tarpon season, deposits non-refundable after Feb 5 and full charter amount due if cancelled · If weather pushes tarpon offshore, inshore fishing offered at tarpon half day rate ($1200) · Kids fishing camp cancellations before or on Feb 1 get 100% refund; after Feb 1 no refunds · Cancellations 21 days or less from camp start forfeit all payments
